pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Show-inputs
steps.run:
echo "Version: ${{ inputs.version }}  " >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "Release branch: ${{ inputs.branch }}  " >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "Workflow branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}  " >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "Deploy skip: ${{ inputs.deploy-skip }}  " >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

steps.name: Create version change commit
steps.run:
./set-version.sh ${{ inputs.version }}
git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git commit -a -m "Set version to ${{ inputs.version }}"

steps.name: Create tag commit
steps.run: git tag --force ${{ inputs.version }}

steps.name: Push tag with version changes
steps.run: git push --force origin refs/tags/${{ inputs.version }}

steps.name: Deploy to Maven
steps.run:
MVN_HTTP_CONFIG="-Dhttp.keepAlive=false -Dmaven.wagon.http.pool=false -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.class=standard -Dmaven.wagon.http.retryHandler.count=3 -Dmaven.wagon.httpconnectionManager.ttlSeconds=120"
mvn -nsu -B -Pgpg,jboss-release -Pcentral-staging -DskipTests -DskipTestsuite $MVN_HTTP_CONFIG clean deploy | tee deploy.log

steps.name: Show Maven artifacts
steps.run: cat deploy.log | grep "central-staging/" | grep -v '.xml$' | grep -v '.asc$' | grep -v '.pom$' | grep -v 'javadoc.jar$' | grep -v 'sources.jar$' | grep -v 'source-release.zip' | grep -v 'central-bundle.zip' | grep -o "/central-staging/.*" | grep -o "/org/keycloak/.*" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

pipelines.name: Keycloak Client Tests

steps.name: Run client tests against Keycloak Server 26.x

client-tests-srv-nightly.name: Client tests using Keycloak Server Nightly

steps.name: Run client tests
Run admin client tests with Jackson 3
steps.run:
VERSION=$(mvn -B -q help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -DforceStdout -f admin-client-jackson3/pom.xml)
JAR=~/.m2/repository/org/keycloak/keycloak-admin-client-jackson3/${VERSION}/keycloak-admin-client-jackson3-${VERSION}.jar
if ! jar tf "$JAR" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.class$'; then
  echo "No Jackson 3 classes available, skipping"
  exit 0
fi
mvn -B -f testsuite/providers/pom.xml package -DskipTests=true
mvn -B -f testsuite/admin-client-tests/pom.xml test -Pjackson3 -Dkeycloak.version.docker.image=${{ matrix.keycloak_server_version }}

steps.name: Run client tests
steps.run:
mvn -B -f testsuite/providers/pom.xml package -DskipTests=true

podman run --detach --rm --name keycloak --net host -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin \
  -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin -e KC_HOSTNAME=localhost \
  -e KC_HTTPS_KEY_STORE_FILE=/opt/keycloak/providers/server.keystore -e KC_HEALTH_ENABLED=true \
  -v ./testsuite/providers/target/providers:/opt/keycloak/providers:ro \
  "quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:${{ matrix.keycloak_server_version }}" start --features=scripts

podman logs -f keycloak &

retries=0
while [[ $(curl -sk https://localhost:9000/health | jq -r ".status") != "UP" ]]; do
  sleep 10;
  retries=$((retries+1))
  if [ $retries -gt 10 ]; then
    exit 1
  fi
done

JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME_11_X64}" mvn -B -f testsuite/admin-client-tests/pom.xml test \
  -Dkeycloak.lifecycle=remote -Dkeycloak.remote.url=https://localhost:8443 \
  "-Dkeycloak.remote.trustStore=${PWD}/testsuite/providers/target/classes/client.truststore"
JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME_11_X64}" mvn -B -f testsuite/authz-tests/pom.xml test test \
  -Dkeycloak.lifecycle=remote -Dkeycloak.remote.url=https://localhost:8443 \
  "-Dkeycloak.remote.trustStore=${PWD}/testsuite/providers/target/classes/client.truststore"

pipelines.name: Sync with Keycloak Server and send PR with changes

steps.name: Find latest Keycloak release branch
steps.run:
LATEST_RELEASE=$(git ls-remote --heads https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak.git 'release/*' | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}' | sort -V | tail -n1)
echo "KEYCLOAK_RELEASE_BRANCH_NAME=release/$LATEST_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Checkout Keycloak branch to sync from
Build Keycloak Locally
steps.run:
# just a simple build with sources
./mvnw -ntp install  -V -e -DskipTests -DskipExamples -Pjboss-release

steps.name: Checkout Keycloak Client branch to sync to
Sync Keycloak sources
steps.run: ./.github/scripts/sync-keycloak-sources.sh

steps.name: Config git and GitHub CLI
steps.run:
echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | gh auth login --with-token
git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Check for changes
steps.run:
if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain client-common-synced client-common-synced-jackson3 admin-client admin-client-jackson3 authz-client)" ]; then
  echo "No changes detected in synced modules. Stopping the workflow."
  echo "CHANGES_CHECK=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
else
  echo "CHANGES_CHECK=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
fi

steps.name: Create and push new branch
steps.run:
TIMESTAMP=$(date +'%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
BRANCH_NAME="sync-with-keycloak-server-${{ env.KEYCLOAK_RELEASE_BRANCH_NAME }}-${TIMESTAMP}"
git checkout -b $BRANCH_NAME
git add client-common-synced
git add client-common-synced-jackson3
git add admin-client
git add admin-client-jackson3
git add authz-client
git commit -s -m "Sync with Keycloak server release branch ${{ env.KEYCLOAK_RELEASE_BRANCH_NAME }}" -m "Closes #${{ steps.create_issue.outputs.result }}" --author="${GITHUB_ACTOR} <${GITHUB_ACTOR}@users.noreply.github.com>"
git log -1 --pretty=%B
git push --set-upstream origin $BRANCH_NAME

steps.name: Create pull request with gh CLI
steps.run:
PR_TITLE="Sync with Keycloak server ${{ env.KEYCLOAK_RELEASE_BRANCH_NAME }} branch"
PR_BODY="Closes #${{ steps.create_issue.outputs.result }}

This PR syncs keycloak-client with the Keycloak branch ${{ env.KEYCLOAK_RELEASE_BRANCH_NAME }}"
gh pr create --draft --base ${{env.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_BRANCH }} --head "$BRANCH_NAME" --title "$PR_TITLE" --body "$PR_BODY"
